descriptionMarkdown:
● A character survives catastrophic damage or a narrative 
injury that clearly exceeds normal hit-point loss.
● A character is reduced to 0 HP by a critical hit, and the 
GM has announced that the encounter can cause 
lasting injuries.
● A disease, toxin, environmental hazard or boss ability 
explicitly calls for a lasting injury check.
● The player chooses an injury as the consequence of 
surviving an otherwise fatal situation.
Do not impose permanent disfigurement, limb loss or 
involuntary cybernetics as a hidden consequence of one 
roll. Those outcomes should be discussed with the 
affected player.
